subject: Re: Meeting mix-up
text:
Dear Alex,
Although we were former classmates, I want to handle this properly. I’m writing to apologize for the mix-up in today’s meeting link. I sent the wrong location, and that confusion was frustrating for you. In addition, my train was delayed at the central station, which caused a late arrival. That is no excuse for the error, but I wanted to explain it clearly. I have already updated the invitation and attached the corrected calendar entry. Please let me know if the new time still works for you. If not, I can find another slot this week. Thank you for your patience, and I hope the rest of your day improves.
Kind regards
Riley
